messages:
emma: heads-up: planning a tiny canary for mahogany-7b:v4 tonight in the 01:00-02:00 UTC change window. target: 3% for 15m then 15% if green.
raj: quick Q: do we need to pin enterprise/prod tenants?
emma: yes — pin enterprise -> mahogany-7b:v3 for the first 30m. rachel, can you apply?
rachel: on it. will set TTL 1h. POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"enterprise","model":"mahogany-7b:v3","ttl":"1h"} done.
sre-ops: fallback ordering proposed: 1) tenant pin, 2) mahogany-7b:v3, 3) ember-6b-quant. pinning protects contracts.
raj: alerts? recommend p95 > 800ms OR error_rate > 2x baseline for 3m to trigger rollback. also watch qps drop > 15%.
emma: agree. add semantic regression check: smoke eval set SMOKE_MAHO_V4; watch hallucination + safety prompts.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable mahogany-7b:v4 --micro 3% --window=2026-03-30T01:00Z-02:00Z --monitors=p50,p95,errors,qps --note="mahogany v4 micro canary"
raj: rollback commands?
deploy-bot: full rollback: `/run deploy catalog rollback --model=mahogany-7b:v4 --to=mahogany-7b:v3 --reason="canary-failure"`
deploy-bot: stop canary only: `/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=mahogany-7b:v4 --percent=0`
emma: preflight checklist: pins applied, smoke eval pass, oncall ack. assigning oncall: @raj primary @sre-ops backup.
sre-ops: oncall ack. dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/mahogany-v4-canary
rachel: smoke eval: PASS. hallucination rate unchanged. proceeding when you start.
emma: starting micro-rollout at +7m to let pin propagate. will post +5m metrics.
deploy-bot: starting micro canary now. will post a brief metric snapshot at +5m and at steady.
sre-ops: +5m snapshot: p50=110ms p95=420ms errors=baseline. no alerts.
raj: looks good. move to 15% after 15m steady if no regressions.
emma: scaling to 15% now.
sre-ops: after scale: p95=470ms errors trending flat. no page.
emma: final checks passed. will remove enterprise pin in 40m unless anything else pops. posting changelog note afterwards. :tada:
rachel: will update catalog changelog and ping #general with short release note after window.
emma: thanks all, thread closed unless any issues.
